target.title: feat(grok): handle ask_user_question and exit_plan_mode client extensions
target.body:
## Summary

Grok Build's ACP agent invokes **vendor client extension methods** for interactive tools:

- `_x.ai/ask_user_question` — multiple-choice questionnaires
- `_x.ai/exit_plan_mode` — plan approval (approve / request changes / abandon)

acpx previously rejected unknown `extMethod` calls with Method not found, so these tools always failed when running `acpx grok-build` (while Grok's own TUI works because it implements the methods).

This PR implements:

1. Wire parsers + response builders (`src/acp/grok-ask-user.ts`, `src/acp/grok-exit-plan.ts`)
2. `AcpClient.extMethod` handlers with interactive CLI prompts (TTY)
3. Optional host callbacks on `AcpClientOptions` (`onAskUserQuestion`, `onExitPlanMode`) for embedders
4. Unit tests + wire-format notes under `docs/`
5. **Live behavior proof** against real `grok agent stdio` (see below)

Wire formats were reverse-engineered against `grok agent stdio` (live capture).

## Live behavior proof (2026-07-18)

High-confidence live reproduction is attached:

- [`docs/proof-2026-07-18-grok-ext-methods/`](https://github.com/scottzx/1acp/tree/feat/grok-client-ext-methods/docs/proof-2026-07-18-grok-ext-methods) — **PASS**, `failures: []`
- Re-run: `pnpm exec tsx scripts/grok-ext-live-proof.mts` (requires `grok` on PATH)

| Scenario | Status |
| --- | --- |
| ask_user_question accepted | PASS |
| exit_plan_mode approved | PASS |
| exit_plan_mode rejected | PASS |
| exit_plan_mode abandoned | PASS |

Method: spawn real `grok agent stdio` via `AcpClient`, supply host callbacks that return canned outcomes, assert tool_call updates complete without `Method not found` (map-keyed answers + lower_snake outcomes).

## Test plan

- [x] `pnpm exec tsx --test test/grok-ask-user.test.ts test/grok-exit-plan.test.ts`
- [x] oxlint / build on commit hook
- [x] Live: host-callback path for ask_user_question → accepted (transcript attached)
- [x] Live: host-callback path for exit_plan_mode → approved / rejected / abandoned (transcript attached)
- [ ] Optional: interactive TTY prompts via `acpx grok-build` (callbacks short-circuit CLI UX; unit tests cover prompt builders)

## Notes

- Not included: any WebSocket bridge or product UI (downstream/product-specific).
- Host callbacks follow the same embedding pattern as `onPermissionRequest`.
